propositions: When a local child's direct parent is a non-epic type in an epic-only Jira project, the parent field is suppressed outbound, leaving the child without context in Jira.
An echo-safe breadcrumb comment must be emitted from the outbound comment differ to point Jira users to the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key, never re-ingested inbound.
The breadcrumb uses a stable identity tag to deduplicate across passes, appending only once even if the nearest represented ancestor changes later.
Intervening ancestors lacking bound Jira keys are walked past silently; if any exist, the body notes their non-representation.
The breadcrumb body carries both RECONCILER_MARKER and PARENT_BREADCRUMB_TAG; inbound suppression relies solely on RECONCILER_MARKER substring check.
No breadcrumb is emitted if no bound ancestor exists, or if the direct parent is an epic, or if the parent is absent from the local graph.
